headlines.title: 国务院关税税则委员会：在2个月内继续暂停实施24%的对美加征关税税率，保留10%的对美加征关税税率

headlines.title_en: State Council Tariff Commission: 24% additional tariff rate on US goods to remain suspended for another 2 months, 10% additional tariff rate on US goods retained
headlines.summary_en: To implement the outcomes and consensus reached at the Washington meeting between the Chinese and US heads of state, in accordance with the Tariff Law of the People's Republic of China, the Customs Law of the People's Republic of China, the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China and other laws and regulations and the basic principles of international law, and with the approval of the State Council, starting from 13:01 on November 10, 2026, the additional tariff measures stipulated in the Tariff Commission of the State Council Announcement on Additional Tariffs on Imported Goods Originating in the United States (Tariff Commission Announcement No. 4 of 2025) will be adjusted: the 24% additional tariff rate on US goods will continue to be suspended for two months, while the 10% additional tariff rate on US goods will be retained. (Website of the Ministry of Finance of China)

headlines.title: 国家统计局：本月PPI环比运行的主要特点有三点
headlines.summary: 从环比看，全国PPI上涨0.7%，涨幅比上月回落0.5个百分点。本月PPI环比运行的主要特点：一是输入性和季节性因素影响主要能源相关行业价格上涨。国际能源价格上行带动国内石油和天然气开采业、煤炭开采和洗选业价格分别上涨6.0%和2.7%；受上游基础能源价格传导和迎峰度冬关键准备期电煤及燃气需求释放等因素影响，下游精炼石油产品制造、有机化学原料制造、煤炭加工、燃气生产和供应业价格分别上涨6.8%、6.8%、3.2%和1.5%，6个行业合计影响PPI环比上涨约0.61个百分点，超过总涨幅的八成。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: Three main features of this month's PPI month-on-month movements
headlines.summary_en: On a month-on-month basis, the national PPI rose 0.7%, 0.5 percentage points lower than the previous month. The main features of this month's PPI month-on-month performance: First, input and seasonal factors affected price increases in major energy-related industries. Rising international energy prices drove domestic oil and natural gas extraction and coal mining and washing prices up 6.0% and 2.7%, respectively; affected by the transmission of upstream basic energy prices and the release of demand for thermal coal and gas during the key preparation period for winter peak demand, downstream refined petroleum product manufacturing, organic chemical raw material manufacturing, coal processing, and gas production and supply prices rose 6.8%, 6.8%, 3.2% and 1.5%, respectively. Together, the six industries contributed about 0.61 percentage points to the month-on-month increase in PPI, more than 80% of the total increase.

headlines.title_en: A-share midday review: ChiNext Index gains slightly narrowed, components sector leads
headlines.summary_en: A-shares' three major stock indices all opened higher this morning. The ChiNext Index opened up more than 1% and then narrowed its gains amid volatility. As of the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index was up 0.46%, the Shenzhen Component Index was up 0.27%, the ChiNext Index was up 0.56%, and the STAR 50 was up 0.7%. Turnover in the two markets exceeded RMB 1 trillion, and more than 2,650 stocks rose across the market. By sector, coal, aerospace equipment, components, optical fiber concepts and other sectors led the gains. Tourism retail, energy storage concepts, batteries and other sectors bucked the trend and fell.
